sections.heading: AWARDS
items: Columbus City Schools Staff Excellence Award (2022)
Westfield Elementary Employee of the Month — March 2021

sections.heading: SUMMARY
items: Organized and dependable administrative professional with 6+ years supporting school operations across front office, student services, and faculty coordination. Adept at managing high-traffic environments with warmth and efficiency, maintaining accurate records, and serving as a reliable point of contact for students, parents, and staff.

items.title: Senior Administrative Assistant, Westfield Elementary School
items.subtitle: OH
bullets: Serves as the primary point of contact for a 450-student elementary school, managing front office operations including visitor check-in, phone communications, and daily correspondence with parents and district staff.
Maintains and updates student records in PowerSchool, coordinates substitute teacher scheduling, and supports the principal with meeting preparation and calendar management.
Organizes school-wide events including open house nights, parent-teacher conference scheduling, and end-of-year ceremonies for 400+ attendees.

items.title: Administrative Assistant, Hillcrest Middle School
items.subtitle: OH
bullets: Managed attendance tracking and reporting for a 600-student school, liaising with teachers and parents to resolve discrepancies and ensure compliance with district policy.
Handled procurement of office and classroom supplies, tracking expenditures against a departmental budget.
Supported the front office team during peak enrollment periods, processing new student registrations and maintaining up-to-date emergency contact records.

items.title: Administrative Volunteer, Columbus Reads Literacy Program
items.subtitle: OH
bullets: Supported program coordinators at a nonprofit literacy initiative operating across 8 Columbus-area schools, handling volunteer scheduling, attendance tracking, and supply coordination.
Drafted weekly communications to school liaisons and maintained a database of 150+ active volunteers.
Assisted in organizing quarterly parent engagement events and compiled program outcome reports submitted to district leadership.

items.title: Front Office Digital Transition
bullets: Led the school's shift from paper-based to digital filing for student records, coordinating with the district IT team and training 5 office staff members on the new system.
Reduced record retrieval time by an estimated 50%.

items.title: Student Records Audit & Clean-Up Initiative
bullets: Conducted a full audit of physical and digital student records across Hillcrest Middle School's 600-student roster, identifying and resolving 80+ filing inconsistencies and outdated emergency contact entries.
